lines.zh: 我的靴子踩在墓道石板上，很响。
lines.en: My boots ring loud on the tomb slabs.

lines.zh: 我扛着盾，一步步往前压。
lines.en: I carry my shield and press forward.

lines.zh: 甲片相碰，声音一路跟着我。
lines.en: My plates knock together as I walk.

lines.zh: 我不跑，跑不是战士的走法。
lines.en: I do not run; running is not a warrior's gait.

lines.zh: 尸鬼在我旁边，我们一起推进。
lines.en: Draugr walk beside me; we advance together.

lines.zh: 我的步幅很稳，像量过一样。
lines.en: My stride is steady, as if measured.

lines.zh: 我绕过祭坛，不碰上面的东西。
lines.en: I skirt the altar without touching it.
My blade hangs at my right side.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，火把都暗一下。
lines.en: Torches dim where I pass.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上来，膝盖有点僵。
lines.en: I come up the stairs; my knees are stiff.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，听前面的回声。
lines.en: I stop each step, listening to the echo.

lines.zh: 这身甲很重，但我扛得住。
lines.en: This armor is heavy. I bear it.
I stand with the shield before me.

lines.zh: 甲里没有心跳，只有回声。
lines.en: No heartbeat in this armor, only echoes.

lines.zh: 墓道的风从我肋骨间穿过。
lines.en: The tomb wind passes between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我握了握剑柄，试了试手劲。
lines.en: I grip the hilt and test my strength.
I wait for the order. I do not move.
It is dark inside my helmet.
I turn my head slowly, watching.

lines.zh: 甲上有一道很深的缺口。
lines.en: There is a deep notch in my armor.

lines.zh: 我不需要休息，只需要命令。
lines.en: I need no rest, only orders.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的心跳，没有。
lines.en: I count my heartbeats. There are none.

lines.zh: 你站在墓里，不该在这里。
lines.en: You stand in the tomb. You should not be here.
I raise my shield. You should understand.
You are shorter than me, and you have flesh.
I hold still and watch you first.
You hold your sword too high.

lines.zh: 你这身装备，我见过太多回。
lines.en: I have seen gear like yours many times.
They all stayed here.
If you wish to fight, step forward.
I stand in the doorway.
The treasure here is not yours.
A dent, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我后脚踩实，把身子稳回。
lines.en: My rear foot plants and steadies me.

lines.zh: 我不会疼，但我知道受损了。
lines.en: I feel no pain, but I know I am damaged.
That found a gap in the plates.
A crack in my shoulder socket; it is off.
My shield keeps rising.

lines.zh: 你想砍倒我，要多来几下。
lines.en: You will need more blows to bring me down.
My pauldron is askew.

lines.zh: 指骨在剑柄上又收紧一圈。
lines.en: My finger bones tighten around the hilt.

lines.zh: 这一剑有分量，可惜差一寸。
lines.en: That swing had weight, but an inch short.

lines.zh: 食物该摆在坟前，不是手里。
lines.en: Food belongs at a grave, not in your hand.
You show food to the dead.
I have no stomach.
This is of no use to me.
What I want is your life.
Holding it leaves you unguarded.
I forgot hunger long ago.

lines.zh: 把它收起来，别挡在剑前。
lines.en: Put it away; do not hold it against my blade.
My warriors need no feeding.
Do not hold it before your shield.
You hit my shield and fell back.
Not a dent in my armor.

lines.zh: 别挡在墓道中间，退边上去。
lines.en: Do not block the corridor; step to the side.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的肩膀该疼了。
lines.en: Your shoulder should ache after that.
I do not retreat. The door is behind me.
You bounced back half a step.
The slabs ring under us.
Do not walk along my blade.

lines.zh: 你推我，只推动了地上的灰。
lines.en: You shove me, and only the dust moves.
Again, and I press you with the shield.
The dead have no need of it.
I stopped being a person long ago.
There is only cold in this body.
My companions are all in the earth.
Do not speak of it in a tomb.

lines.zh: 我记得有过家，别的忘了。
lines.en: I recall having a home. The rest is gone.
You ask the wrong thing.
My oath matters more.
Leave. I must return to the door.
I will not answer twice.
I pick up an old coin.
This was not buried with me.
I pin it with the shield and take it.
Too heavy; I set down my shield to lift it.
It is bitterly cold in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它夹在胸甲和肋骨之间。
lines.en: I wedge it between breastplate and ribs.
Ash? I know it.
I lift it, look, and put it down.
I do not touch the belongings of the dead.
This should stay with the tomb.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在地砖上滑了一下。
lines.en: Your boot slips on the flagstone.
I raise the shield to my chest.

lines.zh: 三步之内，我的剑就到了。
lines.en: Three paces, and my blade is there.

lines.zh: 我的剑尖朝下，已经准备好。
lines.en: My point is low and ready.

lines.zh: 你站在我守的那道门前。
lines.en: You stand before the door I guard.

lines.zh: 活人的汗味从石缝里渗进来。
lines.en: Living sweat seeps through the stone seams.
The draugr have formed up behind me.
First I will cut off your retreat.
That torch in your hand will fall.
My raised blade is the beginning.
I have practised this blow for centuries.
Heavy armor, but my strike is not slow.

lines.zh: 拔剑的是你，我只是站着。
lines.en: You drew first; I only stood here.
My helm squares up on you.
The tomb door will not open for you.

lines.zh: 你背后是墙，前面是我的盾。
lines.en: A wall behind you, my shield ahead.

lines.zh: 我把盾挪了半寸，正对你。
lines.en: I shift my shield half an inch to face you.

lines.zh: 我按着甲片的节奏往前挪。
lines.en: I advance to the rhythm of my plates.
You retreat; I advance.
I hold the doorway. You cannot leave.
My shield stays turned to you.
The draugr come around the flank.

lines.zh: 你挪到左边，我的盾就跟过去。
lines.en: You move left; my shield follows.
No hurry. My armor is thick.
You hit my shield. Useless.

lines.zh: 火苗矮下去了，光要没了。
lines.en: The flame is sinking; your light is going.
I wait for your strength to run out.
My blade stays raised.

lines.zh: 你鞋跟压住了祭坛的刻纹。
lines.en: Your heel presses on the altar's carving.

lines.zh: 你每踩一块石板，我都听着。
lines.en: I hear every slab you step on.

lines.zh: 这道墓廊只通一个门洞。
lines.en: This corridor leads to a single doorway.
I stand there.
Retreat further and you meet the wall.
My hand has not trembled.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，所以我能等。
lines.en: I need not breathe, so I can wait.
I raise a hand: the draugr should wait.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就补上一步。
lines.en: Every step you yield, I take one.
My blade comes down and the slab splits.
This blow is heavy. You will fall back.
I knock your blade aside with the shield.
The blade comes from the right. You cannot stop it.

lines.zh: 我的甲卸掉了大半力道。
lines.en: My armor takes most of the force.

lines.zh: 你别指望砍断我的骨头。
lines.en: Do not expect to cut my bones.
I step in and press you.
I keep a second cut in reserve.

lines.zh: 温血溅上铁甲，很快变凉。
lines.en: Warm blood hits cold iron and cools fast.
I give half a step, then hold.
My blade is heavier than yours.

lines.zh: 我缓慢地抬手，落得很快。
lines.en: I raise my arm slowly and drop it fast.
The draugr will fill my gap.
This blow is for the tomb's master.
You fall back; I hold.

lines.zh: 盾沿一抬，磕上你的下颌。
lines.en: My shield rim snaps up into your jaw.
I push myself up out of the sarcophagus.
Ash covers my armor.
My first breath does not go in.
My bones realign inside the armor.
I grip the coffin rim and rise.

lines.zh: 火把的光刺进我的眼窝。
lines.en: Torchlight stings my eye sockets.
I find my sword and grip it.
I remember which door I guard.
The tomb is quiet but for me.
I raise the shield and scan the room.
Someone walks above.
I head for the stairs.
My steps raise the dust.
I am the first wave.

lines.zh: 火在甲上烧，我不觉得烫。
lines.en: Fire burns on the armor. I feel no heat.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下，甲响了一路。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs, armor ringing.
Water fills the armor and I grow heavy.
The blast throws me onto the coffin.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder gap.
A curse slips into my bones, cold.
I am not hungry, yet the body empties.

lines.zh: 雷穿过甲，我的骨头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning crosses the armor; my bones light up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石板，我落了下去。
lines.en: No slab below; I fall.
